decision: scoped this run to build phases 1-3 with a fake AI client
why: operator picked phases 1-3 first and has no API key for tests

decision: done = pytest green plus scripts/e2e.py driving the real CLI and server through login, capture and the checklist gate
why: check the real product, not just unit tests

decision: built auth as plain functions over the DB with an injectable clock: argon2, sessions, CSRF, lockout, TOTP, device flow, rotating refresh
why: lets tests drive lockout, expiry and device polling without sleeping

decision: fixed TOTP check to use the injected clock instead of wall time
why: test_totp_is_required_once_enabled failed 401 vs 200

decision: recomputed the htmx SRI hash from the CDN file instead of trusting the one written from memory
why: never ship an integrity hash nobody checked

decision: added projects.checklist_built_at and regenerated the initial migration
why: auto-start on check needed an explicit built marker, not a guess from requirements version

decision: lowered priority bands to high>=4, medium>=2.5
why: a high-severity 40-minute failure scored medium, against requirements 9.3

decision: approved rules apply to every project and replace failure items in their category
why: requirements do not define rule matching; global keeps v1 simple and avoids duplicate items

decision: search now covers the first-guess field too
why: e2e search for a word only in the guess found nothing

decision: simulated offline by stopping the server on the same URL instead of pointing at a dead port
why: a different URL also meant different stored credentials, so the check measured the wrong thing

decision: broke offline replay idempotency on purpose to prove the checks can fail
why: 49 checks passing could mean the harness never fails
evidence: mutation run: 2 pytest failures, e2e FAIL on replay check

decision: ran pytest and e2e against a scratch Postgres 15 as well as SQLite
why: production uses Postgres and search takes a tsvector path there
result: 55 tests and 49 e2e checks green on both

decision: sent auth, cross-user access, the gate and CLI credentials to an independent opus reviewer
why: never count my own review as the verdict

decision: reproduced all 6 reviewer findings plus 2 minor notes as failing tests before fixing
why: only fix what a test shows is real

decision: moved lockout from user columns to an in-memory count per username and client address
why: anyone could lock the owner out forever by sending bad passwords

decision: checking the last required item now rebuilds the checklist before auto-starting
why: new history after start could let a project start from a stale checklist (FR-22)

decision: single-use TOTP steps; device link keeps ?code through login; CLI keeps tokens unless refresh gets 401; token file always reset to 0600; queue keeps entries on 429 and 5xx
why: reviewer findings 4-6 and minor notes
result: 63 tests green on sqlite and postgres

decision: documented uvicorn --proxy-headers and --forwarded-allow-ips instead of parsing X-Forwarded-For in app code
why: uvicorn already rewrites the client address when told which proxy to trust

decision: full predicate re-run after fixes
why: phase E

decision: review uses claude-opus-5-5, classification and grading use claude-haiku-5-5, both configurable
why: design asks for a stronger review model and a cheaper one elsewhere; skill says current Opus and Haiku
result: ~$0.16 per review at design token counts (estimate)

decision: every AI call is logged in ai_calls with payload, reply, prompt version, tokens, cost; reviews point at it
why: design 7 requires an audit of exactly what was sent

decision: only ai/client.py imports the SDK and only ai/gate.py calls complete(), enforced by a test
why: design rule: one gate module; a test keeps it true

decision: accepted AI drafts are keyed by review and draft number, not by the cited failure
why: dedupe by failure id silently dropped an accepted AI item

decision: e2e drives the real SDK against a local fake Messages API
why: proves headers, fallbacks, schema and caching on the wire without an API key

decision: capture refuses private, loopback and link-local addresses on every redirect hop
why: the server is internet-facing and fetches user URLs, so a link could reach the host's metadata address
result: mutation check: disabling the guard fails that test

decision: login-path detection applies only to redirect targets
why: a docs page under /docs/auth would have been treated as a login wall

decision: Playwright stays an optional extra and is not exercised
why: it is a large install; design marks it optional

decision: e2e captures from a real local site over HTTP with PREFLIGHT_CAPTURE_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true
why: the fixture site is on 127.0.0.1; production keeps the guard on

decision: a chained shell command committed before tests ran; reran pytest and e2e on that state and amended
why: a failing lint step short-circuited the chain

decision: added scripts/check.sh (lint, tests, e2e under set -e) and run it before each commit
why: a chained command let a commit through before tests ran

decision: the session stamps created_at from the app clock at flush
why: wall-clock created_at disagreed with the injected clock, breaking rule verdicts and weekly windows

decision: all period windows exclude their start and include their end
why: events at exactly now or at rule creation fell out of the window

decision: rule verdict: fewer failures after than before (or none) is working, otherwise needs revision; retired stays manual
why: requirements name the three verdicts but not the rule for retired

decision: question coverage counts answered only, not 'not relevant'
why: literal reading of requirements 12.1

decision: validated the 7-slot category palette in light and dark; light contrast WARN covered by table views
why: dataviz rule: run the validator, never eyeball

decision: rendered the progress page in light, dark and a 390px iframe and looked at it
why: the validator checks color, not layout

decision: e2e covers close, report, weekly, export json/csv/md and the dashboard progress page
why: phase predicate on the real product

decision: added a constraint naming convention to the model metadata
why: Alembic generated an unnamed constraint a second time; the convention fixes every future migration
result: autogenerate shows no other diff; up/down/up ok

decision: drills climb 1, 3, 7, 21 days then grow by SM-2 ease; any score under 3 restarts at 1 day; one drill per failure enforced by a unique constraint
why: requirements FR-37 ladder plus design's SM-2

decision: made the cross-user drill test issue its token after the clock moves and require 404
why: it accepted 401 from an expired token, so it proved nothing

decision: UTCDateTime converts every loaded value to UTC
why: Postgres returned Pacific time and day arithmetic crossed DST by an hour, so a rule verdict never re-ran
evidence: db/base.py; probe showed due 02:00-08:00 vs now 09:00 UTC

decision: independent opus review of phases 4-7 found 2 high, 3 medium, 1 low; gate, cross-user access and export clean
why: never count my own review as the verdict

decision: capture connects to the checked IP literal with the original Host header and TLS name; public means ip.is_global

decision: browser fallback is off unless PREFLIGHT_CAPTURE_BROWSER is set, and when on every browser request passes the address check

result: NOT VERIFIED: Playwright not installed; off by default

decision: AI calls reserve their worst-case cost in a committed row under a per-user lock and are refused when spend plus reservation passes the budget
why: 5 concurrent reviews spent 8x the budget

decision: the AI payload row is committed before the call and any exception is recorded on it
why: a crash after sending lost the audit record

decision: capture streams with a 5 MB cap and a 30 s total deadline; robots redirects are followed and 5xx disallows
why: a 60 MB body was read in full; robots behind a redirect was ignored

decision: drill creation inserts each drill in a savepoint
why: two concurrent requests could hit the unique constraint (reviewer did not run it)

decision: removed the unused secret_key and server api_url settings
why: nothing read them

decision: final predicate
why: phase E
